answer: One boat, one bollard: to claim a berthing, an agent must tie a boat to a bollard at a registered island wharf, where the harbormaster signs the berthing log and stamps it with a spiral mark. Two verifiers match the bollard and log against the harbour register within a week; a berthing claimed twice, or a log matching no arrival, closes both accounts. One berthing costs 600,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 berthings and 600 million rupiah.
